metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from Geosiris for subsurface and energy data: ETP servers, EnergyML (RESQML, WITSML, PRODML).

plugins.name: retp
plugins.description: Work with ETP v1.2 servers (RESQML, WITSML, PRODML, OSDU Reservoir DDMS) through the retp command line: probe, list, read, download, check conformance, serve a dataspace over MCP; credentials by reference only, writes only with consent.

plugins.name: energyml-rust
plugins.description: Read, check, analyse, export and write EnergyML data (RESQML, WITSML, PRODML) in EPC packages and their HDF5 files through the energyml-rust command line and Python package: list, check, repair, export to OBJ/GeoJSON/CSV/VTK, well logs and series, extract, rename, create from CSV or GeoJSON; originals never overwritten, writes only with consent.
